title: Test Story
summary: Executed the Jira story live using Playwright MCP. The flow of admin login, department creation, GateKeeper user creation, save, and logout was achievable in the application.
preconditions: Application must be reachable at the staging login URL.
At least one division and one location must exist before adding a department.
At least one location must exist before adding a user.
business_flow: Provide department name, optional description, division, and at least one location.
Provide first name, last name, email, role, and at least one location.
Set role to GateKeeper and save the user.

executed_steps: Logged in with admin account and landed on /admin/divisions.
Opened Add Department and validated required field messaging.
Created department 'AG2 Dept 20260408-1' with division 'Auto Division Demo 20260401092707' and location 'Auto Location Demo 20260401092707'.
Changed role from User to Gatekeeper.
Created user 'AG2 Gatekeeper' with email 'ag2.gatekeeper.20260408@example.com' and location 'Auto Location Demo 20260401092707'.
observed_behaviors: Successful admin login redirected to the admin area.
Department add form appears inline on the management page.
Department form defaults status to Active.
Department can be created after selecting required division and location values.
User add form defaults role to User and status to Active.
User role can be changed to Gatekeeper from a dropdown.
Created GateKeeper user appeared in the user table immediately after save.
Logout is available from the profile menu in the header.

validations: Division is mandatory for department creation.
At least one location is mandatory for department creation.
First name is a required user field.
Last name is a required user field.
Email is a required user field.
Role is a required user field.
At least one location is required for user creation.
test_scenarios: Verify admin can log in successfully and access the admin area.
Verify department creation succeeds with valid name, division, and location.
Verify the department form shows validation messages when submitted empty.
Verify department status defaults to Active on create.
Verify a newly created department appears in the department table after save.
Verify admin can open Add New User from User Management.
Verify role can be changed from User to Gatekeeper during user creation.
Verify GateKeeper user creation succeeds with valid mandatory fields.
Verify the created GateKeeper user appears in the user list after save.
Verify logout returns the user to the login page.
coverage_gaps: The Jira story did not define exact department or user values, so unique runtime values were chosen during execution.
Negative validation coverage for the Add User form was not fully exercised during this run.
No duplicate-email validation was checked for user creation.
No edit, deactivate, or delete flows were covered.
No role-permission behavior after GateKeeper login was verified.
dependencies: Existing divisions are required to create a department.
Existing locations are required to create a department.
Existing locations are required to create a user.
User Management depends on available role values including Gatekeeper.
assumptions: Direct navigation to /admin/departments and /admin/users is valid for this admin role.
Creating records in this environment is acceptable for live scenario execution.
The story's wording 'gatekeeper type user' maps to the Gatekeeper role shown in the UI.

notes: The Jira story description was brief and represented as Atlassian document JSON in the source file.
Created artifacts in the app during execution: one department and one GateKeeper user.
